## Streyn 1.14.5

- **Invite as contributor or as listener:** Share on a playlist now offers "Link to listen", "Invite as contributor" and "Invite as listener". Contributors can add and remove songs. Listeners get the playlist in their library and always hear the latest version, but can't change it
- **Roles in the playlist:** every member shows whether they contribute or listen. As the owner, tap a name to switch between contributor and listener, or × to remove them
- **Works from anywhere:** both invitations also work through the public link on musik.labtoso.de. The page says which role the invitation gives, and new people can make an account right there
- An invitation never takes rights away: a contributor who opens a listener link stays a contributor

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
